diplomat.name: Diplomat
diplomat.description: Form alliances with distinct civilizations. Re-signing an agreement never counts twice.

trader.name: Trade Envoy
trader.description: Establish trade agreements with distinct civilizations.

colonist.name: Colonist
colonist.description: Complete new landing hubs. Kits under construction do not count.

surveyor.name: Cartographer
surveyor.description: Finish orbital surveys of distinct worlds.

naturalist.name: Naturalist
naturalist.description: Catalogue distinct species. Repeated scans and specimens do not count.

zoologist.name: Zoologist
zoologist.description: Complete new ecosystem tiers. Rebuilding a lost tier never awards it again.

terraformer.name: Terra-Wrangler
terraformer.description: Improve worlds above their native climate tier. Each world's highest achieved tier counts once.

captain.name: Captain
captain.description: Resolve distinct optional space encounters. Declined, failed or repeated outcomes earn no progress.
